title: Crestline Fleet Credit Schedule: Limits, Reviews and Accounts per Business
content:
Crestline Fleet Credit sets the credit terms of every Crestline Fleet Account within the figures of the program the account is on. All amounts are in USD.

## Credit limit range and review cycle

| Program | Smallest credit limit approved | Largest credit limit approved | Months between scheduled credit reviews | Largest increase at one review (percent of current limit) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | 1000.00 | 5000.00 | 12 | 25 |
| Crestline Fleet Business | 5000.00 | 25000.00 | 12 | 25 |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | 15000.00 | 75000.00 | 12 | 50 |
| Crestline Fleet National | 50000.00 | 250000.00 | 12 | 50 |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | 150000.00 | 1000000.00 | 6 | 50 |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | 10000.00 | 500000.00 | 24 | 25 |

## Accounts held by one business

A business profile may hold more than one fleet account, for divisions or branches. The schedule fixes how many, and the highest total of credit limits across all the fleet accounts of one business.

| Program | Fleet accounts one business profile may hold | Highest total of credit limits across the business's fleet accounts |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | 1 | 5000.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Business | 2 | 40000.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | 3 | 150000.00 |
| Crestline Fleet National | 5 | 500000.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | 10 | 2500000.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | 5 | 1000000.00 |

## Application file

| Program | Documents the credit application needs | Owner's personal guarantee required |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | business tax ID; owner ID | yes |
| Crestline Fleet Business | business tax ID; two trade references | yes |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | business tax ID; three trade references; financial statements | no |
| Crestline Fleet National | business tax ID; three trade references; financial statements | no |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | business tax ID; audited financials | no |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | agency tax ID; purchasing authority letter | no |

Tax-exempt invoicing: on every program a tax-exempt invoice needs a valid exemption certificate on file.

## Reading the schedule

- The increase figure is a ceiling for one scheduled review, stated as a percent of the limit in place at that review: on a hypothetical Crestline Fleet Commercial limit of 20000.00, a review can raise it by at most 50 percent of 20000.00, that is 10000.00.
- The review interval is counted in months: every 6 months on Crestline Fleet Enterprise, every 24 months on Crestline Fleet Public Sector, every 12 months on the other four programs.
